stages.name: Synthesis
stages.description: No coordinates yet: mapped library cells and pre-placement timing estimates.

stages.name: Floorplan
stages.description: Core rows, physical support cells, and power distribution before signal placement.

stages.name: Placement
stages.description: Cells have coordinates. This timing snapshot precedes subsequent repair and clock-tree synthesis.

stages.name: Clock tree
stages.description: Clock buffers and timing-repair cells have been inserted. Hold repair has run; signal routing is still ahead.

stages.name: Global routing
stages.description: Signal routes are planned and estimated parasitics updated. These are routing guides, before detailed legal track assignment.

stages.name: Detailed routing
stages.description: Legal tracks and vias connect cells. Filler insertion and parasitic extraction have run; timing is evaluated across all configured corners.

stages.name: Final GDS
stages.description: GDS geometry, including standard-cell internals and routed interconnect. Final metrics come from the latest completed step.
